name: Analytic Normal Computation for SDF Grids
definition: Computes the surface normal n for a differentiable implicit function f defined by a cubic polynomial within a voxel, using analytic derivatives instead of numerical differencing to ensure C2 continuity inside the voxel.
summary: Analytic Normal Computation for SDF Grids computes surface normals within a single voxel using analytic derivatives, avoiding the numerical instability of finite difference methods.
